private theorem standingWave_second_deriv
    (A B : ℂ) (k ω t x : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun y => deriv (standingWave A B k ω t) y) x =
      -((k : ℂ) ^ 2) * standingWave A B k ω t x := by
  have hderiv_fun : deriv (standingWave A B k ω t) = standingWaveDeriv A B k ω t := by
    funext y
    exact standingWave_deriv A B k ω t y
  rw [hderiv_fun]
  calc
    deriv (standingWaveDeriv A B k ω t) x
        = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ) * (t : ℂ)) *
            (A * (((-Complex.sin ((k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))) * (k : ℂ)) * (k : ℂ)) +
              B * ((-(Complex.cos ((k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * (k : ℂ))) * (k : ℂ))) := by
              exact (standingWaveDeriv_hasDerivAt A B k ω t x).deriv
    _ = -((k : ℂ) ^ 2) * standingWave A B k ω t x := by
          simp [standingWave, pow_two]
          ring

private theorem ladderBeta_sq (m ω : ℂ) :
    -(ladderBeta m ω * ladderBeta m ω) = (1 : ℂ) / (m ^ 2 * ω ^ 2) := by
  let a : ℂ := m⁻¹ * (m⁻¹ * (ω⁻¹ * ω⁻¹))
  calc
    -(ladderBeta m ω * ladderBeta m ω)
        = -(Complex.I * (Complex.I * a)) := by
            simp [ladderBeta, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_left_comm, mul_comm, a]
    _ = -((Complex.I * Complex.I) * a) := by ring
    _ = a := by simp
    _ = (1 : ℂ) / (m ^ 2 * ω ^ 2) := by
          simp [a, div_eq_mul_inv, pow_two, mul_inv_rev, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

private theorem qhoScale_sq (m ω ħ : ℝ) (hscale : 0 ≤ m * ω / (2 * ħ)) :
    qhoScale m ω ħ ^ 2 = ((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  simpa [qhoScale] using
    congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ)) (Real.sq_sqrt hscale)

private theorem qhoBeta_sq (m ω : ℝ) :
    -(qhoBeta m ω * qhoBeta m ω) =
      (1 : ℂ) / (((m : ℂ) ^ 2) * ((ω : ℂ) ^ 2)) := by
  simpa [qhoBeta] using ladderBeta_sq (m := (m : ℂ)) (ω := (ω : ℂ))

private theorem annihilation_creation_expand {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Algebra ℂ R]
    (β : ℂ) (x p : R) :
    (x + β • p) * (x - β • p) =
      x * x - β • (x * p) + β • (p * x) + (-(β * β)) • (p * p) := by
  calc
    (x + β • p) * (x - β • p)
        = (x + β • p) * (x + (-β) • p) := by
            simp [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul]
    _ = x * x + x * ((-β) • p) + ((β • p) * x + (β • p) * ((-β) • p)) := by
          rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add]
    _ = x * x + (-β) • (x * p) + (β • (p * x) + (β • p) * ((-β) • p)) := by
          rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = x * x + (-β) • (x * p) + (β • (p * x) + β • ((-β) • (p * p))) := by
          rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    _ = x * x + (-β) • (x * p) + (β • (p * x) + (β * -β) • (p * p)) := by
          rw [smul_smul]
    _ = x * x - β • (x * p) + β • (p * x) + (-(β * β)) • (p * p) := by
          simp [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul, add_assoc]

private theorem creation_annihilation_expand {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Algebra ℂ R]
    (β : ℂ) (x p : R) :
    (x - β • p) * (x + β • p) =
      x * x + β • (x * p) - β • (p * x) + (-(β * β)) • (p * p) := by
  calc
    (x - β • p) * (x + β • p)
        = (x + (-β) • p) * (x + β • p) := by
            simp [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul]
    _ = x * x + x * (β • p) + (((-β) • p) * x + ((-β) • p) * (β • p)) := by
          rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add]
    _ = x * x + β • (x * p) + (((-β) • (p * x)) + ((-β) • p) * (β • p)) := by
          rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = x * x + β • (x * p) + (((-β) • (p * x)) + (-β) • (β • (p * p))) := by
          rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    _ = x * x + β • (x * p) + (((-β) • (p * x)) + ((-β) * β) • (p * p)) := by
          rw [smul_smul]
    _ = x * x + β • (x * p) - β • (p * x) + (-(β * β)) • (p * p) := by
          simp [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul, add_assoc]

/-! ### C1
For the standing-wave solution
`ψ(x,t) = (A sin(kx) + B cos(kx)) e^{-i ω t}`,
the second spatial derivative is `-k^2 ψ`, so the kinetic-energy operator multiplies `ψ`
by `ħ^2 k^2 / (2m)`.
-/
theorem C1 (A B : ℂ) (k ω t ħ m x : ℝ) :
    -(((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * deriv (fun y => deriv (standingWave A B k ω t) y) x =
      (((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) * ((k : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * standingWave A B k ω t x := by
  calc
    -(((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * deriv (fun y => deriv (standingWave A B k ω t) y) x
        = -(((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * (-((k : ℂ) ^ 2) * standingWave A B k ω t x) := by
            rw [standingWave_second_deriv]
    _ = (((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) * ((k : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * standingWave A B k ω t x := by
          ring

/-! ### C2
If `ψ` has the separated time dependence `e^{-i ω t}` and satisfies the
time-dependent Schrödinger equation with zero potential, then the time derivative term
reduces to `ħ ω ψ`.
-/
theorem C2 (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ) (V : ℝ → ℂ) (ħ m ω x t : ℝ)
    (hψ : ψ = separatedState φ ω)
    (hSch :
      Complex.I * (ħ : ℂ) * deriv (fun τ => ψ x τ) t =
        -(((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * deriv (fun ξ => deriv (fun ζ => ψ ζ t) ξ) x +
          V x * ψ x t)
    (hV0 : V x = 0) :
    (ħ : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ) * ψ x t =
      -(((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * deriv (fun ξ => deriv (fun ζ => ψ ζ t) ξ) x := by
  have hlinC₀ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) * z)
      (-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) (t : ℂ) := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (t : ℂ)).const_mul (-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)))
  have hexpC :
      HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Complex.exp ((-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) * z))
        (Complex.exp ((-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) * (t : ℂ)) * (-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ))) (t : ℂ) := by
    exact hlinC₀.cexp
  have hexp :
      HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.exp ((-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ)))
        (Complex.exp ((-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) * (t : ℂ)) * (-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ))) t := by
    simpa using hexpC.comp_ofReal
  have htime :
      deriv (fun τ => ψ x τ) t = -Complex.I * (ω : ℂ) * ψ x t := by
    rw [hψ, separatedState]
    calc
      deriv (fun τ : ℝ => φ x * Complex.exp ((-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ))) t
          = φ x * (Complex.exp ((-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) * (t : ℂ)) * (-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ))) := by
              exact (hexp.const_mul (φ x)).deriv
      _ = -Complex.I * (ω : ℂ) * (φ x * Complex.exp ((-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ)) * (t : ℂ))) := by
            ring
  have htime' :
      Complex.I * (ħ : ℂ) * deriv (fun τ => ψ x τ) t = (ħ : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ) * ψ x t := by
    rw [htime]
    calc
      Complex.I * (ħ : ℂ) * (-Complex.I * (ω : ℂ) * ψ x t)
          = (Complex.I * (-Complex.I)) * ((ħ : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ) * ψ x t) := by ring
      _ = (ħ : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ) * ψ x t := by simp
  calc
    (ħ : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ) * ψ x t = Complex.I * (ħ : ℂ) * deriv (fun τ => ψ x τ) t := htime'.symm
    _ = -(((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * deriv (fun ξ => deriv (fun ζ => ψ ζ t) ξ) x +
          V x * ψ x t := hSch
    _ = -(((ħ : ℂ) ^ 2) / (2 * (m : ℂ))) * deriv (fun ξ => deriv (fun ζ => ψ ζ t) ξ) x := by
          simp [hV0]

/-! ### C3
Combining the kinetic-energy eigenvalue equation with the free-particle Schrödinger equation
gives `ħ ω = ħ^2 k^2 / (2m)`. Using `p = ħ k` and a nonzero wavefunction value yields
`ω = p^2 / (2mħ)`.
-/
theorem C3 {ħ m ω k p ψxt d2ψ : ℂ}
    (hψ : ψxt ≠ 0)
    (hK : -(ħ ^ 2 / (2 * m)) * d2ψ = (ħ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / (2 * m)) * ψxt)
    (hW : ħ * ω * ψxt = -(ħ ^ 2 / (2 * m)) * d2ψ)
    (hp : p = ħ * k)
    (hħ : ħ ≠ 0) :
    ω = p ^ 2 / (2 * m * ħ) := by
  have hcoeff : ħ * ω = ħ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / (2 * m) := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hψ
    calc
      (ħ * ω) * ψxt = ħ * ω * ψxt := by ring
      _ = -(ħ ^ 2 / (2 * m)) * d2ψ := hW
      _ = (ħ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / (2 * m)) * ψxt := hK
  have hp2 : p ^ 2 = ħ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 := by
    rw [hp]
    ring
  calc
    ω = (ħ * ω) / ħ := by
          field_simp [hħ]
    _ = (ħ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / (2 * m)) / ħ := by rw [hcoeff]
    _ = ħ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / (2 * m * ħ) := by
          ring
    _ = p ^ 2 / (2 * m * ħ) := by rw [hp2]

/-! ### C4
Write the annihilation and creation operators as
`a = √(mω / (2ħ)) (x + i p / (mω))` and
`a† = √(mω / (2ħ)) (x - i p / (mω))`,
with the real square-root prefactor viewed inside `ℂ`.
Direct multiplication gives the standard expansion for `a a†`.
-/
theorem C4 {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Algebra ℂ R] (m ω ħ : ℝ) (x p : R)
    (hscale : 0 ≤ m * ω / (2 * ħ)) :
    annihilation m ω ħ x p * creation m ω ħ x p =
      (((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
        (x * x
          - qhoBeta m ω • (x * p)
          + qhoBeta m ω • (p * x)
          + ((1 : ℂ) / (((m : ℂ) ^ 2) * ((ω : ℂ) ^ 2))) • (p * p)) := by
  calc
    annihilation m ω ħ x p * creation m ω ħ x p
        = (qhoScale m ω ħ ^ 2) •
            ((x + qhoBeta m ω • p) * (x - qhoBeta m ω • p)) := by
              simpa [annihilation, creation, pow_two] using
                (smul_mul_smul_comm (qhoScale m ω ħ)
                  (x + qhoBeta m ω • p)
                  (qhoScale m ω ħ)
                  (x - qhoBeta m ω • p))
    _ = (((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
          ((x + qhoBeta m ω • p) * (x - qhoBeta m ω • p)) := by
            rw [qhoScale_sq _ _ _ hscale]
    _ = (((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
          (x * x
            - qhoBeta m ω • (x * p)
            + qhoBeta m ω • (p * x)
            + (-(qhoBeta m ω * qhoBeta m ω)) • (p * p)) := by
              rw [annihilation_creation_expand]
    _ = (((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
          (x * x
            - qhoBeta m ω • (x * p)
            + qhoBeta m ω • (p * x)
            + ((1 : ℂ) / (((m : ℂ) ^ 2) * ((ω : ℂ) ^ 2))) • (p * p)) := by
              rw [qhoBeta_sq]

/-! ### C5
Using the same square-root prefactor, direct multiplication also gives the standard
expansion for `a† a`.
-/
theorem C5 {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Algebra ℂ R] (m ω ħ : ℝ) (x p : R)
    (hscale : 0 ≤ m * ω / (2 * ħ)) :
    creation m ω ħ x p * annihilation m ω ħ x p =
      (((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
        (x * x
          + qhoBeta m ω • (x * p)
          - qhoBeta m ω • (p * x)
          + ((1 : ℂ) / (((m : ℂ) ^ 2) * ((ω : ℂ) ^ 2))) • (p * p)) := by
  calc
    creation m ω ħ x p * annihilation m ω ħ x p
        = (qhoScale m ω ħ ^ 2) •
            ((x - qhoBeta m ω • p) * (x + qhoBeta m ω • p)) := by
              simpa [annihilation, creation, pow_two] using
                (smul_mul_smul_comm (qhoScale m ω ħ)
                  (x - qhoBeta m ω • p)
                  (qhoScale m ω ħ)
                  (x + qhoBeta m ω • p))
    _ = (((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
          ((x - qhoBeta m ω • p) * (x + qhoBeta m ω • p)) := by
            rw [qhoScale_sq _ _ _ hscale]
    _ = (((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
          (x * x
            + qhoBeta m ω • (x * p)
            - qhoBeta m ω • (p * x)
            + (-(qhoBeta m ω * qhoBeta m ω)) • (p * p)) := by
              rw [creation_annihilation_expand]
    _ = (((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
          (x * x
            + qhoBeta m ω • (x * p)
            - qhoBeta m ω • (p * x)
            + ((1 : ℂ) / (((m : ℂ) ^ 2) * ((ω : ℂ) ^ 2))) • (p * p)) := by
              rw [qhoBeta_sq]

aa^\dagger = \frac{m\omega}{2\hbar}\left(\hat{x}^2 - \frac{i}{m\omega}\hat{x}\hat{p} + \frac{i}{m\omega}\hat{p}\hat{x} + \frac{1}{m^2\omega^2}\hat{p}^2\right)
\]

Similarly, for $a^\dagger a$ we get
\[
a^\dagger a = \frac{m\omega}{2\hbar}\left(\hat{x} - \frac{i}{m\omega}\hat{p}\right)\left(\hat{x} + \frac{i}{m\omega}\hat{p}\right)
\]
\[
a^\dagger a = \frac{m\omega}{2\hbar}\left(\hat{x}^2 + \frac{i}{m\omega}\hat{x}\hat{p} - \frac{i}{m\omega}\hat{p}\hat{x} + \frac{1}{m^2\omega^2}\hat{p}^2\right)
\]

Now subtract the two expressions:
\[
aa^\dagger - a^\dagger a = \frac{m\omega}{2\hbar}\left(-\frac{2i}{m\omega}\hat{x}\hat{p} + \frac{2i}{m\omega}\hat{p}\hat{x}\right)
\]
\[
aa^\dagger - a^\dagger a = \frac{i}{\hbar}(\hat{p}\hat{x} - \hat{x}\hat{p})
\]

Hence,
\[
aa^\dagger - a^\dagger a = \frac{i}{\hbar}(\hat{p}\hat{x} - \hat{x}\hat{p})
\]

- **Q2:** For the one-dimensional quantum harmonic oscillator, suppose the annihilation and creation operators satisfy
\[
aa^\dagger - a^\dagger a = \frac{i}{\hbar}(\hat{p}\hat{x} - \hat{x}\hat{p})
\]
Using the canonical commutation relation
\[
[\hat{x},\hat{p}] = i\hbar
\]
prove that
\[
[a,a^\dagger] = 1
\]

  **A2:** By definition of the commutator,
\[
[a,a^\dagger] = aa^\dagger - a^\dagger a
\]

From the given relation,
\[
[a,a^\dagger] = \frac{i}{\hbar}(\hat{p}\hat{x} - \hat{x}\hat{p})
\]

Now we use the commutator definition for $\hat{p}$ and $\hat{x}$:
\[
[\hat{p},\hat{x}] = \hat{p}\hat{x} - \hat{x}\hat{p}
\]

Since
\[
[\hat{x},\hat{p}] = i\hbar
\]
it follows that
\[
[\hat{p},\hat{x}] = -i\hbar
\]

Substituting this into the expression for $[a,a^\dagger]$ gives
\[
[a,a^\dagger] = \frac{i}{\hbar}(-i\hbar)
\]
\[
[a,a^\dagger] = 1
\]

Hence,
\[
[a,a^\dagger] = 1
\]

- **Q3:** Consider the time-independent Schr\"odinger equation for a one-dimensional harmonic oscillator of mass $m$ and angular frequency $\omega$:
\[
\left(-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{d^2}{dx^2} + \frac{m\omega^2}{2}x^2\right)\psi(x) = E\psi(x)
\]
Introduce the dimensionless coordinate
\[
q = \sqrt{\frac{m\omega}{\hbar}}\,x
\]
Show that after this change of variable the equation becomes
\[
\left(-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{m\omega}{\hbar}\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + \frac{m\omega^2}{2}\left(\sqrt{\frac{\hbar}{m\omega}}\,q\right)^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]

  **A3:** We begin with the Schr\"odinger equation
\[
\left(-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{d^2}{dx^2} + \frac{m\omega^2}{2}x^2\right)\psi(x) = E\psi(x)
\]

From the definition of the dimensionless variable $q$,
\[
x = \sqrt{\frac{\hbar}{m\omega}}\,q
\]

Using the chain rule,
\[
\frac{d}{dx} = \sqrt{\frac{m\omega}{\hbar}}\frac{d}{dq}
\]

Therefore the second derivative transforms as
\[
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} = \frac{m\omega}{\hbar}\frac{d^2}{dq^2}
\]

Also, the potential term becomes
\[
x^2 = \left(\sqrt{\frac{\hbar}{m\omega}}\,q\right)^2
\]

Substituting these into the original equation gives
\[
\left(-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{m\omega}{\hbar}\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + \frac{m\omega^2}{2}\left(\sqrt{\frac{\hbar}{m\omega}}\,q\right)^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]

Hence the equation in the variable $q$ is
\[
\left(-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{m\omega}{\hbar}\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + \frac{m\omega^2}{2}\left(\sqrt{\frac{\hbar}{m\omega}}\,q\right)^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]

- **Q4:** For the one-dimensional harmonic oscillator, suppose that after introducing the dimensionless variable
\[
q = \sqrt{\frac{m\omega}{\hbar}}\,x
\]
the Schr\"odinger equation takes the form
\[
\left(-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{m\omega}{\hbar}\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + \frac{m\omega^2}{2}\frac{\hbar}{m\omega}q^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]
Show that this simplifies to
\[
\frac{\hbar\omega}{2}\left(-\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + q^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]

  **A4:** We start from
\[
\left(-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{m\omega}{\hbar}\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + \frac{m\omega^2}{2}\frac{\hbar}{m\omega}q^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]

Now simplify each coefficient separately. For the kinetic term,
\[
-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{m\omega}{\hbar} = -\frac{\hbar\omega}{2}
\]

For the potential term,
\[
\frac{m\omega^2}{2}\frac{\hbar}{m\omega} = \frac{\hbar\omega}{2}
\]

Substituting these simplified coefficients gives
\[
\left(-\frac{\hbar\omega}{2}\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + \frac{\hbar\omega}{2}q^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]

Factoring out the common factor $\hbar\omega/2$, we obtain
\[
\frac{\hbar\omega}{2}\left(-\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + q^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]

Hence,
\[
\frac{\hbar\omega}{2}\left(-\frac{d^2}{dq^2} + q^2\right)\psi(q) = E\psi(q)
\]

- **Q5:** Let $q$ denote multiplication by the coordinate variable and let $\frac{d}{dq}$ denote differentiation with respect to $q$. For any differentiable function $f(q)$, prove that
\[
\left[\frac{d}{dq},q\right]f(q) = f(q)
\]
and hence show that
\[
\left[\frac{d}{dq},q\right] = 1
\]

  **A5:** By definition of the commutator,
\[
\left[\frac{d}{dq},q\right]f(q) = \left(\frac{d}{dq}q - q\frac{d}{dq}\right)f(q)
\]

Applying each operator to $f(q)$ gives
\[
\left(\frac{d}{dq}q - q\frac{d}{dq}\right)f(q) = \frac{d}{dq}(qf(q)) - q\frac{df(q)}{dq}
\]

Now use the product rule:
\[
\frac{d}{dq}(qf(q)) = f(q) + q\frac{df(q)}{dq}
\]

Substituting this result into the commutator expression gives
\[
\left(\frac{d}{dq}q - q\frac{d}{dq}\right)f(q) = \left(f(q) + q\frac{df(q)}{dq}\right) - q\frac{df(q)}{dq}
\]

The derivative terms cancel, so
\[
\left(\frac{d}{dq}q - q\frac{d}{dq}\right)f(q) = f(q)
\]

Therefore,
\[
\left[\frac{d}{dq},q\right]f(q) = f(q)
\]

Since this holds for every differentiable function $f(q)$, the operator identity is
\[
\left[\frac{d}{dq},q\right] = 1
\]

lemma qho_commutator_core
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (m ω ħ α : ℂ) (x p : A)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (hħ : ħ ≠ 0)
    (hα : α ^ 2 = (m * ω) / (2 * ħ)) :
    let γ : ℂ := α * (Complex.I / (m * ω))
    let a : A := α • x + γ • p
    let adag : A := α • x - γ • p
    a * adag - adag * a = (Complex.I / ħ) • (p * x - x * p) := by
  dsimp
  have hmain :
      (α • x + (α * (Complex.I / (m * ω))) • p) * (α • x - (α * (Complex.I / (m * ω))) • p) -
        (α • x - (α * (Complex.I / (m * ω))) • p) * (α • x + (α * (Complex.I / (m * ω))) • p) =
      ((α * (Complex.I / (m * ω))) * α + α * (α * (Complex.I / (m * ω)))) • (p * x - x * p) := by
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_mul, mul_add, smul_smul, mul_comm, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm]
    abel_nf
    simp [two_smul, add_smul]
  rw [hmain]
  have hscalar :
      (α * (Complex.I / (m * ω))) * α + α * (α * (Complex.I / (m * ω))) = Complex.I / ħ := by
    ring_nf
    rw [hα]
    field_simp [hm, hω, hħ]
  rw [hscalar]

/-!
C1 formalises the harmonic-oscillator computation with the literal prefactor
`sqrt (m ω / (2 ħ))` from the physics definition of the annihilation and creation operators.
The proof expands the products and simplifies the scalar coefficient exactly as in the standard derivation.
-/
theorem C1
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (m ω ħ : ℝ) (x p : A)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hω : 0 < ω) (hħ : 0 < ħ) :
    let α : ℂ := (Real.sqrt (m * ω / (2 * ħ)) : ℂ)
    let a : A := α • x + (α * (Complex.I / ((m : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ)))) • p
    let adag : A := α • x - (α * (Complex.I / ((m : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ)))) • p
    a * adag - adag * a = (Complex.I / (ħ : ℂ)) • (p * x - x * p) := by
  have hm_ne : (m : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hm
  have hω_ne : (ω : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hω
  have hħ_ne : (ħ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hħ
  have hα_real : (Real.sqrt (m * ω / (2 * ħ))) ^ 2 = m * ω / (2 * ħ) := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  have hα : ((Real.sqrt (m * ω / (2 * ħ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((m : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ)) / (2 * (ħ : ℂ)) := by
    calc
      ((Real.sqrt (m * ω / (2 * ħ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((m * ω / (2 * ħ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hα_real
      _ = ((m : ℂ) * (ω : ℂ)) / (2 * (ħ : ℂ)) := by
        norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
  simpa using qho_commutator_core (m := (m : ℂ)) (ω := (ω : ℂ)) (ħ := (ħ : ℂ))
    (((Real.sqrt (m * ω / (2 * ħ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) x p hm_ne hω_ne hħ_ne hα

/-!
C2 uses the canonical commutation relation `[x,p] = i ħ` to deduce `[a,a†] = 1`
from the identity obtained in C1.
-/
theorem C2
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (ħ : ℂ) (x p a adag : A)
    (hħ : ħ ≠ 0)
    (ha : a * adag - adag * a = (Complex.I / ħ) • (p * x - x * p))
    (hxp : x * p - p * x = (Complex.I * ħ) • (1 : A)) :
    a * adag - adag * a = 1 := by
  have hpx : p * x - x * p = (-Complex.I * ħ) • (1 : A) := by
    calc
      p * x - x * p = -(x * p - p * x) := by abel_nf
      _ = -((Complex.I * ħ) • (1 : A)) := by rw [hxp]
      _ = (-Complex.I * ħ) • (1 : A) := by simp [mul_comm]
  calc
    a * adag - adag * a = (Complex.I / ħ) • (p * x - x * p) := ha
    _ = (Complex.I / ħ) • ((-Complex.I * ħ) • (1 : A)) := by rw [hpx]
    _ = ((Complex.I / ħ) * (-Complex.I * ħ)) • (1 : A) := by rw [smul_smul]
    _ = (1 : ℂ) • (1 : A) := by
      congr 1
      field_simp [hħ]
      simp [Complex.I_sq]
    _ = (1 : A) := by simp

    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (s q : ℝ)

    intro y
    simpa [one_mul] using (hasDerivAt_id y).const_mul s

    intro y
    have hf' : HasFDerivAt f (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (deriv f (s * y))) (s * y) := by
      exact (hf.differentiableAt : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (s * y)).hasDerivAt.hasFDerivAt
    have hs' : HasFDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => s * t) (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) s) y := by
      exact (hlin y).hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp := hf'.comp y hs'
    simpa [Function.comp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, one_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hcomp.hasDerivAt
  have hfirst_fun :
      deriv (fun y : ℝ => f (s * y)) = fun y : ℝ => ((s : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv f (s * y) := by
    funext y
    exact (hcomp1 y).deriv

    have hf' : HasFDerivAt (deriv f)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (deriv (deriv f) (s * q))) (s * q) := by
      exact (hdf.differentiableAt : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv f) (s * q)).hasDerivAt.hasFDerivAt
    have hs' : HasFDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => s * t) (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) s) q := by
      exact (hlin q).hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp := hf'.comp q hs'
    simpa [Function.comp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, one_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hcomp.hasDerivAt
  have hsecond :
      HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ((s : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv f (s * y)) ((((s : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((s : ℝ) : ℂ)) * deriv (deriv f) (s * q)) q := by

    _ = (((s : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((s : ℝ) : ℂ)) * deriv (deriv f) (s * q) := hsecond.deriv
    _ = ((s^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv f) (s * q) := by

      _ = ((((m * ω) / ħ : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv ψq) q) := by rw [hsecond']; ring

/-!

open Complex

namespace FSLean

def commutator {A : Type*} [Ring A] (x y : A) : A :=
  x * y - y * x

abbrev WaveFunction : Type := ℝ → ℂ

abbrev PositionSpaceOp : Type := WaveFunction → WaveFunction

abbrev invSqrtTwo : ℂ :=
  ((1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

lemma invSqrtTwo_sq : invSqrtTwo * invSqrtTwo = (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
  have hnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hne : (Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpos
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2 = 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg]
  have hreal : (1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    field_simp [hne]
    nlinarith [hsq]
  unfold invSqrtTwo
  have hcomplex :
      (((1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  calc
    (((1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) = (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := hcomplex
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by norm_num

lemma smul_mul_smul {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (z w : ℂ) (x y : A) :
    (z • x) * (w • y) = (z * w) • (x * y) := by
  calc
    (z • x) * (w • y) = z • (x * (w • y)) := by
      rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = z • (w • (x * y)) := by
      rw [mul_smul_comm]
    _ = (z * w) • (x * y) := by
      rw [smul_smul]

lemma I_smul_mul_I_smul {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (x y : A) :
    (Complex.I • x) * (Complex.I • y) = (-1 : ℂ) • (x * y) := by
  calc
    (Complex.I • x) * (Complex.I • y) = Complex.I • (x * (Complex.I • y)) := by
      rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = Complex.I • (Complex.I • (x * y)) := by
      rw [mul_smul_comm]
    _ = ((Complex.I : ℂ) * Complex.I) • (x * y) := by
      rw [smul_smul]
    _ = (-1 : ℂ) • (x * y) := by
      simp

def positionOp : PositionSpaceOp :=
  fun ψ x => (x : ℂ) * ψ x

def momentumOp : PositionSpaceOp :=
  fun ψ x => -(Complex.I) * deriv ψ x

def raisingOp (q : PositionSpaceOp) : PositionSpaceOp :=
  fun ψ x => invSqrtTwo * (-deriv ψ x + q ψ x)

/-!
C1 formalises the raising-operator identity
for position-space wavefunctions `ψ : ℝ → ℂ`.
Here `q` is multiplication by the coordinate, `p = -i d/dq`,
and `a† = (1 / √2) (-d/dq + q)`.
-/
theorem C1 (q p ad : PositionSpaceOp)
    (hq : q = positionOp)
    (hp : p = momentumOp)
    (had : ad = raisingOp q) :
    ad = fun ψ x => invSqrtTwo * (q ψ x - Complex.I * p ψ x) := by
  subst q
  subst p
  subst ad
  funext ψ x
  have hIp : Complex.I * momentumOp ψ x = deriv ψ x := by
    unfold momentumOp
    calc
      Complex.I * (-(Complex.I) * deriv ψ x)
          = (Complex.I * (-Complex.I)) * deriv ψ x := by ring
      _ = deriv ψ x := by
          simp
  calc
    raisingOp positionOp ψ x = invSqrtTwo * (-deriv ψ x + positionOp ψ x) := by
      rfl
    _ = invSqrtTwo * (positionOp ψ x - deriv ψ x) := by
      ring
    _ = invSqrtTwo * (positionOp ψ x - Complex.I * momentumOp ψ x) := by
      rw [hIp]

/-!
C2 formalises the expansion of `a a†` from the definitions
`a = (1 / √2) (q + i p)` and `a† = (1 / √2) (q - i p)`
inside an arbitrary (possibly noncommutative) `ℂ`-algebra.
-/
theorem C2 {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (q p a ad : A)
    (ha : a = invSqrtTwo • (q + Complex.I • p))
    (had : ad = invSqrtTwo • (q - Complex.I • p)) :
    a * ad =
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) •
        (p * p + Complex.I • (p * q) - Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q) := by
  subst a
  subst ad
  have h_expand :
      (q + Complex.I • p) * (q - Complex.I • p) =
        p * p + Complex.I • (p * q) - Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q := by
    calc
      (q + Complex.I • p) * (q - Complex.I • p)
          = (q + Complex.I • p) * q - (q + Complex.I • p) * (Complex.I • p) := by
              rw [mul_sub]
      _ = (q * q + (Complex.I • p) * q) -
            (q * (Complex.I • p) + (Complex.I • p) * (Complex.I • p)) := by
              rw [add_mul, add_mul]
      _ = (q * q + Complex.I • (p * q)) -
            (Complex.I • (q * p) + (-1 : ℂ) • (p * p)) := by
              rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, I_smul_mul_I_smul]
      _ = q * q + Complex.I • (p * q) - Complex.I • (q * p) + p * p := by
              simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
              abel_nf
      _ = p * p + Complex.I • (p * q) - Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q := by
              abel_nf
  calc
    (invSqrtTwo • (q + Complex.I • p)) * (invSqrtTwo • (q - Complex.I • p))
        = (invSqrtTwo * invSqrtTwo) • ((q + Complex.I • p) * (q - Complex.I • p)) := by
            simpa using
              smul_mul_smul invSqrtTwo invSqrtTwo (q + Complex.I • p) (q - Complex.I • p)
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ((q + Complex.I • p) * (q - Complex.I • p)) := by
            rw [invSqrtTwo_sq]
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) •
          (p * p + Complex.I • (p * q) - Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q) := by
            rw [h_expand]

/-!
C3 formalises the analogous expansion of `a† a`
from the same annihilation and creation operator definitions.
-/
theorem C3 {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (q p a ad : A)
    (ha : a = invSqrtTwo • (q + Complex.I • p))
    (had : ad = invSqrtTwo • (q - Complex.I • p)) :
    ad * a =
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) •
        (p * p - Complex.I • (p * q) + Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q) := by
  subst a
  subst ad
  have h_expand :
      (q - Complex.I • p) * (q + Complex.I • p) =
        p * p - Complex.I • (p * q) + Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q := by
    calc
      (q - Complex.I • p) * (q + Complex.I • p)
          = q * (q + Complex.I • p) - (Complex.I • p) * (q + Complex.I • p) := by
              rw [sub_mul]
      _ = (q * q + q * (Complex.I • p)) -
            ((Complex.I • p) * q + (Complex.I • p) * (Complex.I • p)) := by
              rw [mul_add, mul_add]
      _ = (q * q + Complex.I • (q * p)) -
            (Complex.I • (p * q) + (-1 : ℂ) • (p * p)) := by
              rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, I_smul_mul_I_smul]
      _ = q * q + Complex.I • (q * p) - Complex.I • (p * q) + p * p := by
              simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
              abel_nf
      _ = p * p - Complex.I • (p * q) + Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q := by
              abel_nf
  calc
    (invSqrtTwo • (q - Complex.I • p)) * (invSqrtTwo • (q + Complex.I • p))
        = (invSqrtTwo * invSqrtTwo) • ((q - Complex.I • p) * (q + Complex.I • p)) := by
            simpa using
              smul_mul_smul invSqrtTwo invSqrtTwo (q - Complex.I • p) (q + Complex.I • p)
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ((q - Complex.I • p) * (q + Complex.I • p)) := by
            rw [invSqrtTwo_sq]
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) •
          (p * p - Complex.I • (p * q) + Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q) := by
            rw [h_expand]

/-!
C4 packages the subtraction of the two previous expansions,
showing that the difference is `i (p q - q p)`.
-/
theorem C4 {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (q p a ad : A)
    (haa :
      a * ad =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) •
          (p * p + Complex.I • (p * q) - Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q))
    (hda :
      ad * a =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) •
          (p * p - Complex.I • (p * q) + Complex.I • (q * p) + q * q)) :
    a * ad - ad * a = Complex.I • (p * q - q * p) := by
  let x : A := p * p + q * q
  let y : A := Complex.I • (p * q) - Complex.I • (q * p)
  have haa' : a * ad = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (x + y) := by
    rw [haa]
    dsimp [x, y]
    congr 1
    abel_nf
  have hda' : ad * a = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (x - y) := by
    rw [hda]
    dsimp [x, y]
    congr 1
    abel_nf
  rw [haa', hda']
  calc
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (x + y) - (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (x - y)
        = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ((x + y) - (x - y)) := by
            exact (smul_sub (1 / 2 : ℂ) (x + y) (x - y)).symm
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ((2 : ℂ) • y) := by
          have hxy : (x + y) - (x - y) = y + y := by
            abel_nf
          rw [hxy, two_smul]
    _ = ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (2 : ℂ)) • y := by
          rw [smul_smul]
    _ = y := by
          norm_num
    _ = Complex.I • (p * q - q * p) := by
          dsimp [y]
          rw [smul_sub]

/-!
C5 turns the identity from C4 into the standard commutator statement
`[a, a†] = 1` once the canonical commutation relation `[q, p] = i` is assumed.
-/
theorem C5 {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (q p a ad : A)
    (haa : a * ad - ad * a = Complex.I • (p * q - q * p))
    (hqp : commutator q p = Complex.I • (1 : A)) :
    commutator a ad = (1 : A) := by
  unfold commutator at hqp ⊢
  calc
    a * ad - ad * a = Complex.I • (p * q - q * p) := haa
    _ = Complex.I • (-(q * p - p * q)) := by
          congr 1
          abel_nf
    _ = Complex.I • (-(Complex.I • (1 : A))) := by
          rw [hqp]
    _ = Complex.I • ((-Complex.I : ℂ) • (1 : A)) := by
          simp
    _ = ((Complex.I : ℂ) * (-Complex.I)) • (1 : A) := by
          rw [smul_smul]
    _ = (1 : A) := by
          simp

end FSLean

/-- The commutator `[x,y] = xy - yx`. -/
def qcomm {A : Type*} [Ring A] (x y : A) : A :=
  x * y - y * x

/-- The one-dimensional harmonic-oscillator Hamiltonian `H = ℏ ω (a† a + 1/2)`. -/
def harmonicOscillatorHamiltonian {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (ℏ ω : ℂ) (a adag : A) : A :=
  (ℏ * ω) • (adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A)))

/-- The Heisenberg-picture position operator `x_H(t) = U(t) x V(t)`. -/
def heisenbergPosition {A : Type*} [Mul A]
    (U : ℝ → A) (x : A) (V : ℝ → A) : ℝ → A :=
  fun t => (U t * x) * V t

lemma sub_eq_neg_swap {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (x y : G) : x - y = -(y - x) := by
  abel

/-!
C1 formalises the expansion of `[H,a]` for the harmonic-oscillator Hamiltonian
`H = harmonicOscillatorHamiltonian ℏ ω a adag` in an arbitrary complex algebra.
-/
theorem C1
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (ℏ ω : ℂ) (H a adag : A)
    (hH : H = harmonicOscillatorHamiltonian ℏ ω a adag) :
    qcomm H a
      = (- (ℏ * ω)) • ((a * adag - adag * a) * a) := by
  rw [hH, harmonicOscillatorHamiltonian]
  calc
    qcomm ((ℏ * ω) • (adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A)))) a
        = (ℏ * ω) • ((adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A))) * a) -
            (ℏ * ω) • (a * (adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A)))) := by
          rw [qcomm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    _ = (ℏ * ω) •
          (((adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A))) * a) -
            a * (adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A)))) := by
          rw [← smul_sub]
    _ = (ℏ * ω) •
          (adag * a * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • a) -
            (a * adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • a))) := by
          simp [add_mul, mul_add, mul_assoc]
    _ = (ℏ * ω) • (adag * a * a - a * adag * a) := by
          congr 1
          abel
    _ = (ℏ * ω) • ((adag * a - a * adag) * a) := by
          rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    _ = (ℏ * ω) • (-((a * adag - adag * a) * a)) := by
          congr 1
          rw [sub_eq_neg_swap, neg_mul]
    _ = (- (ℏ * ω)) • ((a * adag - adag * a) * a) := by
          rw [smul_neg, neg_smul]

to the standard identity `[H,a] = -ℏ ω • a`.

    (ℏ ω : ℂ) (H a adag : A)
    (h_comm : qcomm H a = (- (ℏ * ω)) • ((a * adag - adag * a) * a))
    (h_canonical : qcomm a adag = 1) :
    qcomm H a = (- (ℏ * ω)) • a := by

    qcomm H a = (- (ℏ * ω)) • ((a * adag - adag * a) * a) := h_comm
    _ = (- (ℏ * ω)) • (qcomm a adag * a) := by

`H = harmonicOscillatorHamiltonian ℏ ω a adag`.

    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]

    (hH : H = harmonicOscillatorHamiltonian ℏ ω a adag) :

  rw [hH, harmonicOscillatorHamiltonian]
  calc
    qcomm ((ℏ * ω) • (adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A)))) adag
        = (ℏ * ω) • ((adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A))) * adag) -
            (ℏ * ω) • (adag * (adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A)))) := by
          rw [qcomm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    _ = (ℏ * ω) •
          (((adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A))) * adag) -
            adag * (adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : A)))) := by
          rw [← smul_sub]
    _ = (ℏ * ω) •
          (adag * a * adag + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • adag) -
            (adag * adag * a + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • adag))) := by
          simp [add_mul, mul_add, mul_assoc]
    _ = (ℏ * ω) • (adag * a * adag - adag * adag * a) := by
          congr 1
          abel
    _ = (ℏ * ω) • (adag * (a * adag - adag * a)) := by
          rw [mul_sub, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

/-!
C4 uses `[a,a†] = 1` to simplify the C3 expression to `[H,a†] = ℏ ω • a†`.
-/
theorem C4
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (ℏ ω : ℂ) (H a adag : A)
    (h_comm : qcomm H adag = (ℏ * ω) • (adag * (a * adag - adag * a)))
    (h_canonical : qcomm a adag = 1) :
    qcomm H adag = (ℏ * ω) • adag := by
  calc
    qcomm H adag = (ℏ * ω) • (adag * (a * adag - adag * a)) := h_comm
    _ = (ℏ * ω) • (adag * qcomm a adag) := by
          rfl
    _ = (ℏ * ω) • (adag * (1 : A)) := by
          rw [h_canonical]
    _ = (ℏ * ω) • adag := by
          simp

/-!
C5 formalises the Heisenberg-picture product-rule step.
Here `expPos t = exp(iHt/ℏ)`, `expNeg t = exp(-iHt/ℏ)`, and
`xH = heisenbergPosition expPos x expNeg`. The hypothesis
`deriv (fun _ => x) t = 0` encodes that the Schrödinger-picture operator `x`
has no explicit time dependence.
-/
theorem C5
    {A : Type*} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A]
    (expPos expNeg xH : ℝ → A) (x : A) (t : ℝ)
    (hxH : xH = heisenbergPosition expPos x expNeg)
    (h_expPos : DifferentiableAt ℝ expPos t)
    (h_expNeg : DifferentiableAt ℝ expNeg t)
    (hx_static : deriv (fun _ : ℝ => x) t = 0) :
    deriv xH t
      = (deriv expPos t * x) * expNeg t + (expPos t * x) * deriv expNeg t := by
  rw [hxH]
  change deriv (fun s : ℝ => (expPos s * x) * expNeg s) t
      = (deriv expPos t * x) * expNeg t + (expPos t * x) * deriv expNeg t
  have hUx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s : ℝ => expPos s * x) t :=
    (h_expPos.hasDerivAt.mul_const x).differentiableAt
  have hx_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun _ : ℝ => x) t :=
    differentiableAt_const x
  have hUx_formula :
      deriv (fun s : ℝ => expPos s * x) t
        = deriv expPos t * x + expPos t * deriv (fun _ : ℝ => x) t := by
    simpa using (deriv_mul (c := expPos) (d := fun _ : ℝ => x) h_expPos hx_diff)
  calc
    deriv (fun s : ℝ => (expPos s * x) * expNeg s) t
        = deriv (fun s : ℝ => expPos s * x) t * expNeg t
            + (expPos t * x) * deriv expNeg t := by
          simpa using (deriv_mul (c := fun s : ℝ => expPos s * x) (d := expNeg) hUx h_expNeg)
    _ = (deriv expPos t * x + expPos t * deriv (fun _ : ℝ => x) t) * expNeg t
            + (expPos t * x) * deriv expNeg t := by
          rw [hUx_formula]
    _ = (deriv expPos t * x) * expNeg t + (expPos t * x) * deriv expNeg t := by
          rw [hx_static, mul_zero, add_zero]

          simp only [mul_assoc, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    _ = (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) • (H * (U t * (x * V t))) -
          (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) • (U t * (x * (H * V t))) := by
          simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul]
    _ = (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) • (H * (U t * (x * V t)) - U t * (x * (H * V t))) := by
          rw [smul_sub]

C2 introduces an explicit Heisenberg observable `x_H(t)` and rewrites the
product-rule formula into the standard commutator form, using that `H`
commutes with `e^{-iHt/ħ}`.

theorem C2
    (ħ : ℂ) (H x : Op n) (U V xH : ℝ → Op n) (t : ℝ)
    (hxH : ∀ s, xH s = heisenbergPosition U x V s)
    (hcomm : ∀ s, Commute H (V s))
    (hEq :
      deriv xH t =
        (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) •
          (H * heisenbergPosition U x V t - U t * (x * (H * V t)))) :
    deriv xH t = (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) • (H * xH t - xH t * H) := by
  have hxHt : xH t = heisenbergPosition U x V t := hxH t
  have hsecond :
      U t * (x * (H * V t)) = heisenbergPosition U x V t * H := by
    calc
      U t * (x * (H * V t)) = U t * (x * (V t * H)) := by rw [(hcomm t).eq]
      _ = U t * ((x * V t) * H) := by simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = (U t * (x * V t)) * H := by simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = heisenbergPosition U x V t * H := by rfl
  calc
    deriv xH t
        = (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) •
            (H * heisenbergPosition U x V t - U t * (x * (H * V t))) := hEq
    _ = (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) •
          (H * heisenbergPosition U x V t - heisenbergPosition U x V t * H) := by
          rw [hsecond]
    _ = (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) • (H * xH t - xH t * H) := by
          rw [← hxHt]

def commutator (A B : Op n) : Op n := A * B - B * A

/-!

`[H, X]`.
-/
theorem C3
    (ħ : ℂ) (H : Op n) (xH : ℝ → Op n) (t : ℝ)
    (hEq :
      deriv xH t = (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) • (H * xH t - xH t * H)) :
    deriv xH t = (Complex.I / ħ : ℂ) • commutator H (xH t) := by
  simpa [commutator] using hEq

end HeisenbergPicture

section HarmonicOscillator

/-- The classical Hamiltonian underlying the one-dimensional harmonic oscillator. -/
def oscillatorHamiltonian (m ω x p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  p ^ 2 / (2 * m) + ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * x ^ 2

/-- The time-dependent Hamiltonian `H(t)` obtained by evaluating the oscillator
formula along the trajectories `x(t)` and `p(t)`. -/
def heisenbergOscillatorHamiltonian (m ω : ℝ) (x p : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  fun t => oscillatorHamiltonian m ω (x t) (p t)

/-- The Hamiltonian viewed as a function of momentum with position frozen at
the instantaneous value `x(t)`. -/
def oscillatorHamiltonianAtPosition (m ω x_t : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  fun q => oscillatorHamiltonian m ω x_t q

/-- The Hamiltonian viewed as a function of position with momentum frozen at
the instantaneous value `p(t)`. -/
def oscillatorHamiltonianAtMomentum (m ω p_t : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  fun q => oscillatorHamiltonian m ω q p_t

/-!
C4 models the Heisenberg observables by time-dependent scalar trajectories
`x(t)` and `p(t)`.  The time-dependent Hamiltonian is
`H(t) = heisenbergOscillatorHamiltonian m ω x p t`, and the canonical
equation `d x(t) / dt = ∂H/∂p` is evaluated by freezing `x(t)` and
differentiating with respect to the momentum variable.
-/
theorem C4
    (m ω : ℝ) (x p : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (hcanon :
      deriv x t = deriv (oscillatorHamiltonianAtPosition m ω (x t)) (p t)) :
    deriv x t = p t / m := by
  have hfreeze :
      oscillatorHamiltonianAtPosition m ω (x t)
        = (fun q : ℝ => q ^ 2 / (2 * m) + ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * (x t) ^ 2) := by
    funext q
    simp [oscillatorHamiltonianAtPosition, oscillatorHamiltonian]
  have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun q : ℝ => q ^ 2) (2 * p t) (p t) := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (p t)).pow 2
  have hkin : HasDerivAt (fun q : ℝ => q ^ 2 / (2 * m)) ((2 * p t) / (2 * m)) (p t) := by
    simpa using hsq.div_const (2 * m)
  have htotal :
      HasDerivAt
        (fun q : ℝ => q ^ 2 / (2 * m) + ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * (x t) ^ 2)
        ((2 * p t) / (2 * m)) (p t) := by
      convert hkin.add (hasDerivAt_const (p t) (((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * (x t) ^ 2)) using 1
      simp
  calc
    deriv x t = deriv (oscillatorHamiltonianAtPosition m ω (x t)) (p t) := hcanon
    _ = deriv (fun q : ℝ => q ^ 2 / (2 * m) + ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * (x t) ^ 2) (p t) := by
          rw [hfreeze]
    _ = (2 * p t) / (2 * m) := htotal.deriv
    _ = p t / m := by
          field_simp [hm]

/-!
C5 uses the same time-dependent trajectories and evaluates the canonical
equation `d p(t) / dt = - ∂H/∂x` by freezing `p(t)` and differentiating
the Hamiltonian with respect to the position variable.
-/
theorem C5
    (m ω : ℝ) (x p : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hcanon :
      deriv p t = -deriv (oscillatorHamiltonianAtMomentum m ω (p t)) (x t)) :
    deriv p t = -(m * ω ^ 2 * x t) := by
  have hfreeze :
      oscillatorHamiltonianAtMomentum m ω (p t)
        = (fun q : ℝ => (p t) ^ 2 / (2 * m) + ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * q ^ 2) := by
    funext q
    simp [oscillatorHamiltonianAtMomentum, oscillatorHamiltonian]
  have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun q : ℝ => q ^ 2) (2 * x t) (x t) := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (x t)).pow 2
  have hpot :
      HasDerivAt
        (fun q : ℝ => ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * q ^ 2)
        (((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * (2 * x t)) (x t) := by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hsq.const_mul ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2)
  have htotal :
      HasDerivAt
        (fun q : ℝ => (p t) ^ 2 / (2 * m) + ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * q ^ 2)
        (((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * (2 * x t)) (x t) := by
      convert (hasDerivAt_const (x t) ((p t) ^ 2 / (2 * m))).add hpot using 1
      simp
  calc
    deriv p t = -deriv (oscillatorHamiltonianAtMomentum m ω (p t)) (x t) := hcanon
    _ = -deriv (fun q : ℝ => (p t) ^ 2 / (2 * m) + ((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * q ^ 2) (x t) := by
          rw [hfreeze]
    _ = -(((m * ω ^ 2) / 2) * (2 * x t)) := by rw [htotal.deriv]
    _ = -(m * ω ^ 2 * x t) := by ring

end HarmonicOscillator

end

end Autoformal

    ∀ t, x t = Real.cos (ω * t) • x 0 + Real.sin (ω * t) • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p 0) := by

    calc
      x 0 = Real.cos (ω * 0) • A + Real.sin (ω * 0) • B := by rw [hshape]
      _ = A := by simp
  intro t
  calc
    x t = Real.cos (ω * t) • A + Real.sin (ω * t) • B := by rw [hshape]
    _ = Real.cos (ω * t) • x 0 + Real.sin (ω * t) • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p 0) := by
      rw [← hA, hB]

import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Add
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Comp

/-!
This file formalizes five short harmonic-oscillator derivations.

The observables are not collapsed to scalar-valued trajectories. Instead, they take values in an
abstract commutative normed `ℝ`-algebra `A`, so `x(t)` and `p(t)` are time-dependent observable
elements. The linear Heisenberg-picture arguments in C1, C2, C4, and C5 only use the scalar
action and additive structure of `A`. The multiplicative structure is used explicitly in C3 to
formalize the harmonic-oscillator Hamiltonian as a quadratic polynomial in the position
observable.
-/

open Polynomial

namespace Autoformal

noncomputable section

variable {A : Type*} [NormedCommRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A]

lemma hasDerivAt_cos_mul (ω t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) (-ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) t := by
  convert (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (ω * t)).comp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul ω) using 1
  ring

lemma hasDerivAt_sin_mul (ω t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) (ω * Real.cos (ω * t)) t := by
  convert (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (ω * t)).comp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul ω) using 1
  ring

lemma deriv_cos_mul (ω t : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) t = -ω * Real.sin (ω * t) :=
  (hasDerivAt_cos_mul ω t).deriv

lemma deriv_sin_mul (ω t : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) t = ω * Real.cos (ω * t) :=
  (hasDerivAt_sin_mul ω t).deriv

lemma hasDerivAt_harmonic_position (x0 p0 : A) (m ω t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun s : ℝ =>
        Real.cos (ω * s) • x0 + Real.sin (ω * s) • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0))
      (deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) t • x0
        + deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) t • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0))
      t := by
  have hcos :
      HasDerivAt
        (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s) • x0)
        (deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) t • x0)
        t := by
    simpa [deriv_cos_mul ω t] using (hasDerivAt_cos_mul ω t).smul_const x0
  have hsin :
      HasDerivAt
        (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s) • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0))
        (deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) t • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0))
        t := by
    simpa [deriv_sin_mul ω t] using
      (hasDerivAt_sin_mul ω t).smul_const ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0)
  simpa using hcos.add hsin

def hamiltonianPoly {A : Type*} [NormedCommRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A]
    (pVal : A) (m ω : ℝ) : Polynomial A :=
  C ((1 / (2 * m : ℝ)) • (pVal * pVal)) +
    C (algebraMap ℝ A (((m * ω^2) / 2 : ℝ))) * X^2

lemma hamiltonianPoly_derivative {A : Type*} [NormedCommRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A]
    (pVal xVal : A) (m ω : ℝ) :
    aeval xVal (Polynomial.derivative (hamiltonianPoly pVal m ω)) =
      ((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • xVal := by
  calc
    aeval xVal (Polynomial.derivative (hamiltonianPoly pVal m ω))
      = aeval xVal
          (C ((algebraMap ℝ A (((m * ω^2) / 2 : ℝ))) * 2) * X) := by
            rw [hamiltonianPoly, Polynomial.derivative_add, Polynomial.derivative_C, zero_add,
              Polynomial.derivative_C_mul_X_sq]
    _ = ((algebraMap ℝ A (((m * ω^2) / 2 : ℝ))) * 2) * xVal := by
          rw [aeval_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X]
          rfl
    _ = (algebraMap ℝ A ((((m * ω^2) / 2 : ℝ) * 2))) * xVal := by
          have htwo : algebraMap ℝ A (2 : ℝ) = (2 : A) := by
            simpa using (map_ofNat (algebraMap ℝ A) 2)
          rw [← htwo, ← map_mul]
    _ = (algebraMap ℝ A (m * ω^2)) * xVal := by
          congr 1
          ring
    _ = ((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • xVal := by
          rw [Algebra.smul_def]

/-!
C1 formalizes Q1/A1: if the position observable has the harmonic-oscillator form in the
observable algebra `A` and its Heisenberg equation is `dx/dt = (1/m) • p`, then differentiating
the explicit formula for `x` gives the claimed expression for `(1/m) • p`.
-/
theorem C1
    {x p : ℝ → A} {x0 p0 : A} {m ω t : ℝ}
    (hPosition :
      x = fun s =>
        Real.cos (ω * s) • x0 + Real.sin (ω * s) • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0))
    (hHeisenberg : deriv x t = (1 / m : ℝ) • p t) :
    (1 / m : ℝ) • p t =
      deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) t • x0
        + deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) t • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0) := by
  calc
    (1 / m : ℝ) • p t = deriv x t := by
      symm
      exact hHeisenberg
    _ =
        deriv
          (fun s =>
            Real.cos (ω * s) • x0 + Real.sin (ω * s) • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0))
          t := by
            simp [hPosition]
    _ =
        deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) t • x0
          + deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) t • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0) := by
            exact (hasDerivAt_harmonic_position x0 p0 m ω t).deriv

/-!
C2 formalizes Q2/A2: starting from the expression for `(1/m) • p(t)`, substitute the
trigonometric derivatives and rescale by `m` to obtain the standard closed form for `p(t)`.
-/
theorem C2
    {p : ℝ → A} {x0 p0 : A} {m ω t : ℝ}
    (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (hMomentum :
      (1 / m : ℝ) • p t =
        deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) t • x0
          + deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) t • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0)) :
    p t = Real.cos (ω * t) • p0 - (m * ω * Real.sin (ω * t) : ℝ) • x0 := by
  have hmw : m * ω ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hm hω
  calc
    p t = (m : ℝ) • ((1 / m : ℝ) • p t) := by
      rw [smul_smul]
      have hm_inv : (m : ℝ) * (1 / m : ℝ) = 1 := by field_simp [hm]
      rw [hm_inv, one_smul]
    _ =
        (m : ℝ) •
          (deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) t • x0
            + deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) t • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0)) := by
              rw [hMomentum]
    _ =
        (m : ℝ) •
          ((-ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) • x0
            + (ω * Real.cos (ω * t)) • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0)) := by
              rw [deriv_cos_mul, deriv_sin_mul]
    _ =
        ((m : ℝ) * (-ω * Real.sin (ω * t))) • x0
          + ((m : ℝ) * (ω * Real.cos (ω * t))) • ((1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) • p0) := by
            rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    _ =
        (-(m * ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) : ℝ) • x0
          + (((m : ℝ) * (ω * Real.cos (ω * t))) * (1 / (m * ω) : ℝ)) • p0 := by
            have hsin :
                ((m : ℝ) * (-ω * Real.sin (ω * t))) = -(m * ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) := by
              ring
            rw [hsin, smul_smul]
    _ = (-(m * ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) : ℝ) • x0
          + (Real.cos (ω * t) : ℝ) • p0 := by
            have hscalar :
                ((m : ℝ) * (ω * Real.cos (ω * t))) * (1 / (m * ω) : ℝ) =
                  Real.cos (ω * t) := by
              field_simp [hmw]
            rw [hscalar]
    _ = Real.cos (ω * t) • p0 + (-(m * ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) : ℝ) • x0 := by
      ac_rfl
    _ = Real.cos (ω * t) • p0 - (m * ω * Real.sin (ω * t) : ℝ) • x0 := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_smul]

/-!
C3 formalizes Q3/A3 using the Hamiltonian polynomial in the position observable. The kinetic term
is constant in `x`, while the quadratic potential contributes the derivative
`(m * ω^2) • x(t)`. Substituting that derivative into Hamilton's equation gives the required
momentum equation.
-/
theorem C3
    {x p : ℝ → A} {m ω t : ℝ}
    (hHamilton :
      deriv p t = -aeval (x t) (Polynomial.derivative (hamiltonianPoly (p t) m ω))) :
    deriv p t = -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • x t := by
  calc
    deriv p t = -aeval (x t) (Polynomial.derivative (hamiltonianPoly (p t) m ω)) := hHamilton
    _ = -(((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • x t) := by
      rw [hamiltonianPoly_derivative]
    _ = -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • x t := by
      conv_rhs => rw [neg_smul]

/-!
C4 formalizes Q4/A4 from the time-dependent momentum equation of motion
`deriv p = fun t => -m * ω^2 • x t`. Differentiating that identity once more gives the stated
second-order relation.
-/
theorem C4
    {x p : ℝ → A} {m ω t : ℝ}
    (hMomentumEq : deriv p = fun s : ℝ => -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • x s)
    (hx : HasDerivAt x (deriv x t) t) :
    deriv (deriv p) t = -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • deriv x t := by
  have hRhs :
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • x s)
        (-((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • deriv x t) t := by
    simpa using hx.const_smul (-((m * ω^2 : ℝ)))
  calc
    deriv (deriv p) t = deriv (fun s : ℝ => -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • x s) t := by
      simp [hMomentumEq]
    _ = -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • deriv x t := by
      exact hRhs.deriv

/-!
C5 formalizes Q5/A5: combining the second-order momentum equation with the Heisenberg equation
`dx/dt = (1/m) • p` and cancelling the nonzero scalar `m` shows that momentum itself satisfies
the harmonic-oscillator equation.
-/
theorem C5
    {x p : ℝ → A} {m ω t : ℝ}
    (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (hSecond : deriv (deriv p) t = -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • deriv x t)
    (hHeisenberg : deriv x t = (1 / m : ℝ) • p t) :
    deriv (deriv p) t = -((ω^2 : ℝ)) • p t := by
  calc
    deriv (deriv p) t = -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • deriv x t := hSecond
    _ = -((m * ω^2 : ℝ)) • ((1 / m : ℝ) • p t) := by
      rw [hHeisenberg]
    _ = (((-(m * ω^2 : ℝ)) * (1 / m : ℝ)) : ℝ) • p t := by
      rw [smul_smul]
    _ = -((ω^2 : ℝ)) • p t := by
      congr 1
      field_simp [hm]

end

end Autoformal

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Deriv

namespace FSLean

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- The operator-valued harmonic-oscillator ansatz
`p(t) = A cos(ω t) + B sin(ω t)`, written using scalar actions. -/
noncomputable def momentumAnsatz (A B : E) (ω : ℝ) : ℝ → E :=
  fun t => Real.cos (ω * t) • A + Real.sin (ω * t) • B

theorem hasDerivAt_omega_mul (ω t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ω * s) ω t := by
  simpa [mul_comm] using (hasDerivAt_mul_const ω : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s * ω) ω t)

theorem hasDerivAt_momentumAnsatz (A B : E) (ω t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (momentumAnsatz A B ω)
      ((-ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) • A + (ω * Real.cos (ω * t)) • B) t := by
  have hcos :
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) (-ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) t := by
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using (hasDerivAt_omega_mul ω t).cos
  have hsin :
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.sin (ω * s)) (ω * Real.cos (ω * t)) t := by
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using (hasDerivAt_omega_mul ω t).sin
  simpa [momentumAnsatz] using (hcos.smul_const A).add (hsin.smul_const B)

/-! C1 formalizes the ansatz
`p(t) = A cos(ω t) + B sin(ω t)` for an operator-valued momentum function.
It proves `A = p(0)` and computes the derivative by differentiating the scalar coefficients. -/
theorem C1 (A B : E) (ω t : ℝ) :
    let p : ℝ → E := momentumAnsatz A B ω
    A = p 0 ∧
      deriv p t = (-ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) • A + (ω * Real.cos (ω * t)) • B := by
  dsimp [momentumAnsatz]
  constructor
  · simp
  · simpa using (hasDerivAt_momentumAnsatz A B ω t).deriv

/-! C2 formalizes the Heisenberg equation
`dp/dt = -m ω^2 x(t)` for the same ansatz.
For the mathematically necessary nonzero-frequency case, the step "divide by `ω`" is encoded
as the explicit premise `ω ≠ 0`, from which we derive
`B = (-m ω) • x(0)`. -/
theorem C2 (A B : E) (x : ℝ → E) (m ω : ℝ)
    (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (hHeis : ∀ t, deriv (momentumAnsatz A B ω) t = (-m * ω ^ 2) • x t) :
    B = (-m * ω) • x 0 := by
  have h0 : ω • B = (-m * ω ^ 2) • x 0 := by
    calc
      ω • B = deriv (momentumAnsatz A B ω) 0 := by
        symm
        calc
          deriv (momentumAnsatz A B ω) 0
              = (-ω * Real.sin (ω * 0)) • A + (ω * Real.cos (ω * 0)) • B := by
                  simpa using (hasDerivAt_momentumAnsatz A B ω 0).deriv
          _ = ω • B := by simp
      _ = (-m * ω ^ 2) • x 0 := hHeis 0
  have h0' :

    exact congrArg (fun v : E => (ω⁻¹ : ℝ) • v) h0

    rw [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring

    B = (ω⁻¹ : ℝ) • (ω • B) := by rw [inv_smul_smul₀ hω]
    _ = (ω⁻¹ : ℝ) • ((-m * ω ^ 2) • x 0) := h0'
    _ = (ω⁻¹ : ℝ) • (ω • ((-m * ω) • x 0)) := by rw [hrewrite]
    _ = (-m * ω) • x 0 := by rw [inv_smul_smul₀ hω]

`p(t) = p(0) cos(ω t) - m ω x(0) sin(ω t)`,
encoded as `momentumAnsatz p0 ((-m * ω) • x0) ω`, and differentiates it explicitly. -/

      = (-ω * Real.sin (ω * t)) • p0 - (m * ω ^ 2 * Real.cos (ω * t)) • x0 := by

    deriv (momentumAnsatz p0 ((-m * ω) • x0) ω) t

            + (ω * Real.cos (ω * t)) • ((-m * ω) • x0) := by
              simpa using (hasDerivAt_momentumAnsatz p0 ((-m * ω) • x0) ω t).deriv

outside the derivative, leaving derivatives only on the scalar trigonometric coefficients. -/
theorem C4 (p0 x0 : E) (m ω t : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s : ℝ =>
      (-ω * Real.sin (ω * s)) • p0 - (m * ω ^ 2 * Real.cos (ω * s)) • x0) t

          - ((m * ω ^ 2) * deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.cos (ω * s)) t) • x0 := by
  let sfun : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.sin (ω * s)
  let cfun : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.cos (ω * s)
  have hsfun :
      HasDerivAt sfun (Real.cos (ω * t) * ω) t := by
    simpa [sfun] using (hasDerivAt_omega_mul ω t).sin
  have hcfun :
      HasDerivAt cfun (-Real.sin (ω * t) * ω) t := by
    simpa [cfun] using (hasDerivAt_omega_mul ω t).cos
  have hsfun' : HasDerivAt sfun (deriv sfun t) t := by
    simpa [hsfun.deriv] using hsfun
  have hcfun' : HasDerivAt cfun (deriv cfun t) t := by
    simpa [hcfun.deriv] using hcfun
  have h :
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (-ω * sfun s) • p0 - (m * ω ^ 2 * cfun s) • x0)
        (((-ω) * deriv sfun t) • p0 - ((m * ω ^ 2) * deriv cfun t) • x0) t := by
    exact ((hsfun'.const_mul (-ω)).smul_const p0).sub
      ((hcfun'.const_mul (m * ω ^ 2)).smul_const x0)
  simpa [sfun, cfun] using h.deriv

    deriv (deriv (momentumAnsatz p0 ((-m * ω) • x0) ω)) t
      = (-ω ^ 2) • momentumAnsatz p0 ((-m * ω) • x0) ω t := by
  have hderiv :
      deriv (momentumAnsatz p0 ((-m * ω) • x0) ω)
        = fun s => (-ω * Real.sin (ω * s)) • p0 - (m * ω ^ 2 * Real.cos (ω * s)) • x0 := by
    funext s
    exact C3 p0 x0 m ω s

  calc
    deriv (fun s : ℝ =>
      (-ω * Real.sin (ω * s)) • p0 - (m * ω ^ 2 * Real.cos (ω * s)) • x0) t

    _ = (-(ω ^ 2) * Real.cos (ω * t)) • p0 + (m * ω ^ 3 * Real.sin (ω * t)) • x0 := by
      have hsin :

        simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using ((hasDerivAt_omega_mul ω t).cos).deriv
      rw [hsin, hcos]
      have h1 : (-ω) * (ω * Real.cos (ω * t)) = -(ω ^ 2) * Real.cos (ω * t) := by

      rw [h1, sub_eq_add_neg]
      congr 1
      rw [← neg_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = (-ω ^ 2) • momentumAnsatz p0 ((-m * ω) • x0) ω t := by
      simp [momentumAnsatz, smul_add, smul_smul]
      ring

    commutator (a + b) c = commutator a c + commutator b c := by

    commutator (a + b) c = (a + b) * c - c * (a + b) := rfl
    _ = (a * c + b * c) - (c * a + c * b) := by rw [add_mul, mul_add]
    _ = (a * c - c * a) + (b * c - c * b) := by abel
    _ = commutator a c + commutator b c := rfl

lemma commutator_add_right (a b c : A) :
    commutator a (b + c) = commutator a b + commutator a c := by
  calc
    commutator a (b + c) = a * (b + c) - (b + c) * a := rfl
    _ = (a * b + a * c) - (b * a + c * a) := by rw [mul_add, add_mul]
    _ = (a * b - b * a) + (a * c - c * a) := by abel
    _ = commutator a b + commutator a c := rfl

end RingLemmas

section ComplexAlgebra

variable [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]

/-- Heisenberg-picture position operator for the one-dimensional oscillator. -/
def xHeis (x₀ p₀ : A) (m ω t : ℝ) : A :=
  ((Real.cos (ω * t) : ℂ) • x₀) +
    ((((Real.sin (ω * t)) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • p₀)

/-- Heisenberg-picture momentum operator for the one-dimensional oscillator. -/
def pHeis (x₀ p₀ : A) (m ω t : ℝ) : A :=
  ((Real.cos (ω * t) : ℂ) • p₀) -
    ((((m * ω) * Real.sin (ω * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) • x₀)

lemma commutator_smul_left (z : ℂ) (a b : A) :
    commutator (z • a) b = z • commutator a b := by
  calc
    commutator (z • a) b = (z • a) * b - b * (z • a) := rfl
    _ = z • (a * b) - z • (b * a) := by
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    _ = z • (a * b - b * a) := by rw [smul_sub]
    _ = z • commutator a b := rfl

lemma commutator_smul_right (z : ℂ) (a b : A) :
    commutator a (z • b) = z • commutator a b := by
  calc
    commutator a (z • b) = a * (z • b) - (z • b) * a := rfl
    _ = z • (a * b) - z • (b * a) := by
      rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = z • (a * b - b * a) := by rw [smul_sub]
    _ = z • commutator a b := rfl

lemma commutator_smul_smul (z w : ℂ) (a b : A) :
    commutator (z • a) (w • b) = (z * w) • commutator a b := by
  rw [commutator_smul_left, commutator_smul_right, smul_smul]

lemma linear_combo_commutator
    (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℂ) (x y : A) :
    commutator (a₁ • x + b₁ • y) (a₂ • x + b₂ • y)
      = ((a₁ * b₂ - a₂ * b₁) • (x * y)) + ((b₁ * a₂ - b₂ * a₁) • (y * x)) := by
  calc
    commutator (a₁ • x + b₁ • y) (a₂ • x + b₂ • y)
      = commutator (a₁ • x) (a₂ • x)
          + commutator (a₁ • x) (b₂ • y)
          + (commutator (b₁ • y) (a₂ • x) + commutator (b₁ • y) (b₂ • y)) := by
            rw [commutator_add_left, commutator_add_right, commutator_add_right]
    _ = 0 + (a₁ * b₂) • commutator x y + ((b₁ * a₂) • commutator y x + 0) := by
          rw [commutator_smul_smul, commutator_smul_smul, commutator_smul_smul,
            commutator_smul_smul]
          simp [commutator_self]
    _ = (a₁ * b₂) • commutator x y + (b₁ * a₂) • commutator y x := by simp
    _ = ((a₁ * b₂ - a₂ * b₁) • (x * y)) + ((b₁ * a₂ - b₂ * a₁) • (y * x)) := by
          rw [commutator, commutator, sub_smul, sub_smul]
          simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm, mul_comm]

/-!
C1 formalizes the direct expansion of the unequal-time position commutator
for the harmonic oscillator. The operators are elements of a noncommutative
`ℂ`-algebra, and the time dependence is encoded by `xHeis`.
-/
theorem C1 (x₀ p₀ : A) (m ω t₁ t₂ : ℝ) :
    commutator (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₁) (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₂)
      =
        ((((Real.cos (ω * t₁) * (Real.sin (ω * t₂) / (m * ω)) -
            Real.cos (ω * t₂) * (Real.sin (ω * t₁) / (m * ω)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
            (x₀ * p₀))) +
        ((((Real.sin (ω * t₁) / (m * ω) * Real.cos (ω * t₂) -
            Real.sin (ω * t₂) / (m * ω) * Real.cos (ω * t₁) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
            (p₀ * x₀))) := by
  simpa [xHeis] using
    (linear_combo_commutator
      (a₁ := (Real.cos (ω * t₁) : ℂ))
      (b₁ := (((Real.sin (ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (a₂ := (Real.cos (ω * t₂) : ℂ))
      (b₂ := (((Real.sin (ω * t₂) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (x := x₀) (y := p₀))

/-!
C2 rewrites the two real trigonometric coefficients from `C1` using the
sine-difference identity `sin (u - v) = sin u cos v - cos u sin v`.
-/
theorem C2 (x₀ p₀ : A) (m ω t₁ t₂ : ℝ)
    (h :
      commutator (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₁) (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₂)
        =
          ((((Real.cos (ω * t₁) * (Real.sin (ω * t₂) / (m * ω)) -
              Real.cos (ω * t₂) * (Real.sin (ω * t₁) / (m * ω)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
              (x₀ * p₀))) +
          ((((Real.sin (ω * t₁) / (m * ω) * Real.cos (ω * t₂) -
              Real.sin (ω * t₂) / (m * ω) * Real.cos (ω * t₁) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
              (p₀ * x₀)))) :
    commutator (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₁) (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₂)
      =
        ((((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (x₀ * p₀))) +
        ((((Real.sin (ω * t₁ - ω * t₂) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (p₀ * x₀))) := by
  rw [h]
  apply congrArg₂ (fun z w : ℝ => ((z : ℂ) • (x₀ * p₀)) + ((w : ℂ) • (p₀ * x₀)))
  · calc
      Real.cos (ω * t₁) * (Real.sin (ω * t₂) / (m * ω)) -
          Real.cos (ω * t₂) * (Real.sin (ω * t₁) / (m * ω))
        = (Real.cos (ω * t₁) * Real.sin (ω * t₂) -
            Real.cos (ω * t₂) * Real.sin (ω * t₁)) / (m * ω) := by
            ring
      _ = Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) := by
            congr 1
            rw [Real.sin_sub]
            ring
  · calc
      Real.sin (ω * t₁) / (m * ω) * Real.cos (ω * t₂) -
          Real.sin (ω * t₂) / (m * ω) * Real.cos (ω * t₁)
        = (Real.sin (ω * t₁) * Real.cos (ω * t₂) -
            Real.sin (ω * t₂) * Real.cos (ω * t₁)) / (m * ω) := by
            ring
      _ = Real.sin (ω * t₁ - ω * t₂) / (m * ω) := by
            congr 1
            rw [Real.sin_sub]
            ring

/-!
C3 factors the `C2` commutator formula by using the oddness of sine and then
pulling out the shared scalar multiple of the equal-time commutator
`[x₀,p₀] = x₀p₀ - p₀x₀`.
-/
theorem C3 (x₀ p₀ : A) (m ω t₁ t₂ : ℝ)
    (h :
      commutator (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₁) (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₂)
        =
          ((((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (x₀ * p₀))) +
          ((((Real.sin (ω * t₁ - ω * t₂) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (p₀ * x₀)))) :
    commutator (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₁) (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₂)
      =
        (((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • commutator x₀ p₀) := by
  rw [h]
  have hodd :
      Real.sin (ω * t₁ - ω * t₂) / (m * ω) =
        -(Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω)) := by
    have hs :
        Real.sin (ω * t₁ - ω * t₂) = -Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) := by
      rw [show ω * t₁ - ω * t₂ = -(ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) by ring]
      simpa using Real.sin_neg (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁)
    rw [hs]
    ring
  calc
    (((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (x₀ * p₀)) +
        (((Real.sin (ω * t₁ - ω * t₂) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (p₀ * x₀))
      = (((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (x₀ * p₀)) -
          (((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (p₀ * x₀)) := by
            rw [hodd]
            simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    _ = (((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          ((x₀ * p₀) - (p₀ * x₀))) := by
            rw [← smul_sub]
    _ = (((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • commutator x₀ p₀) := by
            rfl

/-!
C4 substitutes the canonical equal-time commutator `[x₀,p₀] = i\hbar` into the
factorized unequal-time formula from `C3`. The formal result is written as a
complex scalar multiple of the identity, matching the physics statement more
directly than an `algebraMap` expression.
-/
theorem C4 (x₀ p₀ : A) (m ω t₁ t₂ ħ : ℝ)
    (h :
      commutator (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₁) (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₂)
        =
          (((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ) • commutator x₀ p₀))
    (hcanon : commutator x₀ p₀ = (Complex.I * (ħ : ℂ)) • (1 : A)) :
    commutator (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₁) (xHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₂)
      =
        ((Complex.I * (ħ : ℂ) *
            (((Real.sin (ω * t₂ - ω * t₁) / (m * ω) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) • (1 : A) := by
  rw [h, hcanon, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

/-!
C5 formalizes the direct expansion of the unequal-time momentum commutator for
the same oscillator, starting from the Heisenberg-picture momentum operator
`pHeis`.
-/
theorem C5 (x₀ p₀ : A) (m ω t₁ t₂ : ℝ) :
    commutator (pHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₁) (pHeis x₀ p₀ m ω t₂)
      =
        ((((Real.cos (ω * t₂) * ((m * ω) * Real.sin (ω * t₁)) -
            Real.cos (ω * t₁) * ((m * ω) * Real.sin (ω * t₂)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
            (p₀ * x₀))) +
        ((((((m * ω) * Real.sin (ω * t₂)) * Real.cos (ω * t₁) -
            ((m * ω) * Real.sin (ω * t₁)) * Real.cos (ω * t₂) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
            (x₀ * p₀))) := by
  simpa [pHeis, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using
    (linear_combo_commutator
      (a₁ := (Real.cos (ω * t₁) : ℂ))
      (b₁ := (-(((m * ω) * Real.sin (ω * t₁) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (a₂ := (Real.cos (ω * t₂) : ℂ))
      (b₂ := (-(((m * ω) * Real.sin (ω * t₂) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (x := p₀) (y := x₀))

end ComplexAlgebra

/-- Two basis states for the single-excitation sector are modeled as vectors
`Fin 2 → ℂ`, with index `0` representing `|e,0⟩` and index `1` representing
`|g,1⟩`. -/
abbrev TwoState := Fin 2 → ℂ

/-- The basis vector corresponding to `|e,0⟩`. -/
def e0 : TwoState := Pi.single 0 1

/-- The basis vector corresponding to `|g,1⟩`. -/
def g1 : TwoState := Pi.single 1 1

/-- The finite-dimensional bra-ket pairing used in C5. -/
def braKet (u v : TwoState) : ℂ := ∑ i, star (u i) * v i

/-- The resonant Jaynes-Cummings state in the single-excitation subspace. -/
def psi (Ω t : ℝ) : TwoState :=
  (((Real.cos (Ω * t / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • e0
    + (-Complex.I * (((Real.sin (Ω * t / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))) • g1

lemma braKet_add_right (u v w : TwoState) :
    braKet u (v + w) = braKet u v + braKet u w := by
  unfold braKet
  simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

lemma braKet_smul_right (z : ℂ) (u v : TwoState) :
    braKet u (z • v) = z * braKet u v := by
  unfold braKet
  calc
    ∑ i, star (u i) * ((z • v) i)
        = ∑ i, z * (star (u i) * v i) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
            intro i hi
            simp [Pi.smul_apply, mul_assoc, mul_comm]
    _ = z * ∑ i, star (u i) * v i := by
          symm
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]

/-! C5 computes the excited-state occupation probability by projecting the
state onto `|e,0⟩`, using normalization of `|e,0⟩`, orthogonality with
`|g,1⟩`, and the fact that the surviving amplitude is real. -/
theorem C5 (Ω t : ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq (braKet e0 (psi Ω t))
      = Real.cos (Ω * t / 2) ^ 2 := by
  have he0e0 : braKet e0 e0 = 1 := by
    unfold braKet e0
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp
  have he0g1 : braKet e0 g1 = 0 := by
    unfold braKet e0 g1
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp
  have hamp : braKet e0 (psi Ω t) = ((Real.cos (Ω * t / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    calc
      braKet e0 (psi Ω t)
          = braKet e0 ((((Real.cos (Ω * t / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • e0)
            + braKet e0 ((-Complex.I * (((Real.sin (Ω * t / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))) • g1) := by
                rw [psi, braKet_add_right]
      _ = (((Real.cos (Ω * t / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * braKet e0 e0
            + (-Complex.I * (((Real.sin (Ω * t / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))) * braKet e0 g1 := by
                rw [braKet_smul_right, braKet_smul_right]
      _ = ((Real.cos (Ω * t / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            simp [he0e0, he0g1]
  rw [hamp]
  simpa [pow_two] using Complex.normSq_ofReal (Real.cos (Ω * t / 2))

theorem C1

`expX` is written as an integral of the left-expanded integrand `leftExpanded x = ⟨Ψ|x⟩⟨x|\hat X|Ψ⟩`.

-/
theorem C3
    (leftExpanded psiBra Xpsi psiKet : ℝ → ℂ) (K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (expX : ℂ)
    (hInsertLeft : expX = ∫ x : ℝ, leftExpanded x)
    (hExpandLeft : ∀ x : ℝ, leftExpanded x = psiBra x * Xpsi x)
    (hInsertRight : ∀ x : ℝ, Xpsi x = ∫ x' : ℝ, K x x' * psiKet x') :
    expX = ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ x' : ℝ, psiBra x * K x x' * psiKet x' := by
  rw [hInsertLeft]
  calc
    ∫ x : ℝ, leftExpanded x = ∫ x : ℝ, psiBra x * Xpsi x := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall hExpandLeft
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ x' : ℝ, psiBra x * K x x' * psiKet x' := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
        calc
          psiBra x * Xpsi x
            = psiBra x * ∫ x' : ℝ, K x x' * psiKet x' := by
                rw [hInsertRight x]
          _ = ∫ x' : ℝ, psiBra x * K x x' * psiKet x' := by
                simpa [mul_assoc] using
                  (integral_const_mul (psiBra x)
                    (fun x' : ℝ => K x x' * psiKet x')).symm)

theorem C4
    (integrand afterX overlap δ : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (psiBra psiKet : ℝ → ℂ) (expX : ℂ)
    (hExp : expX = ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ x' : ℝ, integrand x x')
    (hApplyX : ∀ x x' : ℝ, integrand x x' = psiBra x * afterX x x' * psiKet x')
    (hEigen : ∀ x x' : ℝ, afterX x x' = (x' : ℂ) * overlap x x')
    (hBra : ∀ x : ℝ, psiBra x = conj (psiKet x))
    (hOverlap : ∀ x x' : ℝ, overlap x x' = δ x x') :
    expX = ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ x' : ℝ, conj (psiKet x) * (x' : ℂ) * δ x x' * psiKet x' := by
  rw [hExp]
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x' => by
      calc
        integrand x x' = psiBra x * afterX x x' * psiKet x' := by
            rw [hApplyX x x']
        _ = psiBra x * ((x' : ℂ) * overlap x x') * psiKet x' := by
            rw [hEigen x x']
        _ = conj (psiKet x) * (x' : ℂ) * δ x x' * psiKet x' := by
            rw [hBra x, hOverlap x x']
            ring))

/-!
C5 assumes the defining sifting property of the Dirac delta and derives the standard real-valued
position expectation `∫ x |Ψ(x)|² dx`.
-/

        ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ x' : ℝ, conj (ψ x) * (x' : ℂ) * δ x x' * ψ x')
    (hDelta :

          = conj (ψ x) * (x : ℂ) * ψ x) :

  apply Complex.ofReal_inj.mp

      = ∫ x : ℝ, conj (ψ x) * (x : ℂ) * ψ x := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall hDelta
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x * Complex.normSq (ψ x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by

                = (x : ℂ) * (conj (ψ x) * ψ x) := by

    _ = (∫ x : ℝ, x * Complex.normSq (ψ x) : ℝ) := by

open Complex
open scoped ComplexConjugate

/-- In the one-dimensional complex Hilbert model, `⟪ψ, φ⟫ = conj ψ * φ`. -/
def braket (psi phi : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  star psi * phi

lemma ne_zero_of_braket_self_eq_one {psi : ℂ} (h : braket psi psi = 1) : psi ≠ 0 := by
  intro hzero
  rw [braket, hzero, star_zero, zero_mul] at h
  norm_num at h

lemma bra_eigen_of_selfAdjoint {H psi E : ℂ}
    (heig : H * psi = E * psi) (hH : star H = H) (hE : star E = E) :
    star psi * H = E * star psi := by
  have hstar : star psi * star H = star psi * star E := by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using congrArg star heig
  calc
    star psi * H = star psi * star H := by rw [hH]
    _ = star psi * star E := hstar
    _ = star psi * E := by rw [hE]
    _ = E * star psi := by ring

lemma bra_schrodinger_of_selfAdjoint {H psi psit hbar : ℂ}
    (hsch : H * psi = Complex.I * hbar * psit)
    (hH : star H = H) (hhbar : star hbar = hbar) :
    star psi * H = -(Complex.I * hbar) * star psit := by
  have hstar : star H * star psi = -(Complex.I * (star hbar * star psit)) := by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using congrArg star hsch
  calc
    star psi * H = H * star psi := by ring
    _ = star H * star psi := by rw [hH]
    _ = -(Complex.I * (star hbar * star psit)) := hstar
    _ = -(Complex.I * hbar) * star psit := by rw [hhbar]; ring

lemma hasDerivAt_braket {f g : ℝ → ℂ} {x : ℝ} {f' g' : ℂ}
    (hf : HasDerivAt f f' x) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => braket (f y) (g y))
      (braket f' (g x) + braket (f x) g') x := by
  have hstar : HasDerivAt (fun y => star (f y)) (star f') x := hf.star
  simpa [braket] using hstar.mul hg

lemma hasDerivAt_expectation {psi H : ℝ → ℂ} {x : ℝ} {dpsi dH : ℂ}
    (hpsi : HasDerivAt psi dpsi x) (hH : HasDerivAt H dH x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => braket (psi y) (H y * psi y))
      (braket dpsi (H x * psi x) + braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) +
        braket (psi x) (H x * dpsi)) x := by
  have hstar : HasDerivAt (fun y => star (psi y)) (star dpsi) x := hpsi.star
  have hHpsi : HasDerivAt (fun y => H y * psi y) (dH * psi x + H x * dpsi) x := hH.mul hpsi
  have h := hstar.mul hHpsi
  simpa [braket, mul_add, add_mul, mul_assoc, add_assoc] using h

/-!
C1 formalizes Q1 in a minimal one-dimensional complex Hilbert-space model.
The eigenvalue equation and normalization imply that the expectation value
`⟪Ψ_λ, H_λ Ψ_λ⟫` equals `E_λ` pointwise, hence their derivatives agree.
-/
theorem C1 {H psi E : ℝ → ℂ} {x : ℝ}
    (heig : ∀ y, H y * psi y = E y * psi y)
    (hnorm : ∀ y, braket (psi y) (psi y) = 1) :
    deriv E x = deriv (fun y => braket (psi y) (H y * psi y)) x := by
  have hfun : (fun y => braket (psi y) (H y * psi y)) = E := by
    funext y
    calc
      braket (psi y) (H y * psi y) = star (psi y) * (H y * psi y) := rfl
      _ = star (psi y) * (E y * psi y) := by rw [heig y]
      _ = E y * (star (psi y) * psi y) := by ring
      _ = E y * braket (psi y) (psi y) := by rfl
      _ = E y := by rw [hnorm y, mul_one]
  have hderiv := congrArg (fun f : ℝ → ℂ => deriv f x) hfun
  simpa using hderiv.symm

/-!
C2 formalizes Q2.
Starting from the derivative identity from `C1`, we differentiate the
expectation value. The two outer terms are then rewritten using the ket-side
eigenvalue equation together with the scalar self-adjointness of `H x` and the
reality of the eigenvalue `E x`, which is the spectral input corresponding to
the physics statement for a self-adjoint Hamiltonian.
-/
theorem C2 {H psi E : ℝ → ℂ} {x : ℝ} {dpsi dH : ℂ}
    (hE : deriv E x = deriv (fun y => braket (psi y) (H y * psi y)) x)
    (hpsi : HasDerivAt psi dpsi x)
    (hH : HasDerivAt H dH x)
    (heig_ket : H x * psi x = E x * psi x)
    (hHself : star (H x) = H x)
    (hEself : star (E x) = E x) :
    deriv E x =
      E x * braket dpsi (psi x) + braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) + E x * braket (psi x) dpsi := by
  have hprod := (hasDerivAt_expectation hpsi hH).deriv
  have heig_bra : star (psi x) * H x = E x * star (psi x) :=
    bra_eigen_of_selfAdjoint heig_ket hHself hEself
  have h1 : braket dpsi (H x * psi x) = E x * braket dpsi (psi x) := by
    calc
      braket dpsi (H x * psi x) = star dpsi * (H x * psi x) := rfl
      _ = star dpsi * (E x * psi x) := by rw [heig_ket]
      _ = E x * braket dpsi (psi x) := by
        simp [braket, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
  have h3 : braket (psi x) (H x * dpsi) = E x * braket (psi x) dpsi := by
    calc
      braket (psi x) (H x * dpsi) = (star (psi x) * H x) * dpsi := by
        simp [braket, mul_assoc]
      _ = (E x * star (psi x)) * dpsi := by rw [heig_bra]
      _ = E x * braket (psi x) dpsi := by
        simp [braket, mul_assoc]
  calc
    deriv E x = deriv (fun y => braket (psi y) (H y * psi y)) x := hE
    _ = braket dpsi (H x * psi x) + braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) + braket (psi x) (H x * dpsi) := hprod
    _ = E x * braket dpsi (psi x) + braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) + E x * braket (psi x) dpsi := by
      rw [h1, h3]

/-!
C3 formalizes Q3.
Differentiating the normalization condition `⟪Ψ_λ, Ψ_λ⟫ = 1` shows that the
two terms proportional to `E_λ` sum to zero, leaving only
`⟪Ψ_λ, (dH_λ/dλ) Ψ_λ⟫`.

theorem C3 {psi E : ℝ → ℂ} {x : ℝ} {dpsi dH : ℂ}
    (hformula :
      deriv E x =
        E x * braket dpsi (psi x) + braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) + E x * braket (psi x) dpsi)
    (hpsi : HasDerivAt psi dpsi x)
    (hnorm : ∀ y, braket (psi y) (psi y) = 1) :
    deriv E x = braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) := by
  have hnorm_deriv : deriv (fun y => braket (psi y) (psi y)) x = 0 := by
    have hfun : (fun y => braket (psi y) (psi y)) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
      funext y
      exact hnorm y
    have hderiv := congrArg (fun f : ℝ → ℂ => deriv f x) hfun
    simpa using hderiv
  have hsum : braket dpsi (psi x) + braket (psi x) dpsi = 0 := by
    have hself := (hasDerivAt_braket hpsi hpsi).deriv
    rw [hself] at hnorm_deriv
    exact hnorm_deriv
  calc
    deriv E x =
        E x * braket dpsi (psi x) + braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) + E x * braket (psi x) dpsi :=
      hformula
    _ = E x * (braket dpsi (psi x) + braket (psi x) dpsi) + braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) := by
      ring
    _ = braket (psi x) (dH * psi x) := by
      rw [hsum, mul_zero, zero_add]

/-!
C4 formalizes Q4 using a single two-variable state `psi`, together with an
explicit `psil` for `∂_λ Ψ` and `psit` for `∂_t Ψ`. The proof differentiates
the expectation value along the `λ`-slice at fixed `t`, derives the bra-side
Schrödinger identity by conjugating the ket-side one for a self-adjoint scalar
Hamiltonian and real `ħ`, and then solves for
`⟪Ψ_λ(t), (∂H_λ/∂λ) Ψ_λ(t)⟫`.

theorem C4 {H : ℝ → ℂ} {psi psil psit : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ} {lam t : ℝ} {dH hbar : ℂ}

    (hH : HasDerivAt H dH lam)
    (hsch : ∀ l s, H l * psi l s = Complex.I * hbar * psit l s)
    (hHself : ∀ l, star (H l) = H l)
    (hhbar : star hbar = hbar) :
    braket (psi lam t) (dH * psi lam t) =
      Complex.I * hbar * deriv (fun l => braket (psi l t) (psit l t)) lam
        - Complex.I * hbar * braket (psil lam t) (psit lam t)
        + Complex.I * hbar * braket (psit lam t) (psil lam t) := by
  have hprod := (hasDerivAt_expectation hpsi_lam hH).deriv
  have hbra_lam : star (psi lam t) * H lam = -(Complex.I * hbar) * star (psit lam t) :=
    bra_schrodinger_of_selfAdjoint (hsch lam t) (hHself lam) hhbar
  have hderiv_exp :
      deriv (fun l => braket (psi l t) (H l * psi l t)) lam =
        Complex.I * hbar * deriv (fun l => braket (psi l t) (psit l t)) lam := by
    have hfun : (fun l => braket (psi l t) (H l * psi l t)) =
        fun l => Complex.I * hbar * braket (psi l t) (psit l t) := by

      calc
        braket (psi l t) (H l * psi l t) = star (psi l t) * (H l * psi l t) := rfl
        _ = star (psi l t) * (Complex.I * hbar * psit l t) := by rw [hsch l t]
        _ = Complex.I * hbar * braket (psi l t) (psit l t) := by
          simp [braket, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]

    simpa using h

      braket (psil lam t) (H lam * psi lam t) =

    calc
      braket (psil lam t) (H lam * psi lam t) = star (psil lam t) * (H lam * psi lam t) := rfl
      _ = star (psil lam t) * (Complex.I * hbar * psit lam t) := by rw [hsch lam t]
      _ = Complex.I * hbar * braket (psil lam t) (psit lam t) := by
        simp [braket, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]

        simp [braket, mul_assoc]
      _ = (-(Complex.I * hbar) * star (psit lam t)) * psil lam t := by rw [hbra_lam]
      _ = -(Complex.I * hbar) * braket (psit lam t) (psil lam t) := by
        simp [braket, mul_assoc]
  have hsolve :
      braket (psi lam t) (dH * psi lam t) =
        deriv (fun l => braket (psi l t) (H l * psi l t)) lam
          - braket (psil lam t) (H lam * psi lam t)
          - braket (psi lam t) (H lam * psil lam t) := by
    rw [hprod]

    braket (psi lam t) (dH * psi lam t) =
        deriv (fun l => braket (psi l t) (H l * psi l t)) lam
          - braket (psil lam t) (H lam * psi lam t)
          - braket (psi lam t) (H lam * psil lam t) :=
      hsolve
    _ = Complex.I * hbar * deriv (fun l => braket (psi l t) (psit l t)) lam
          - braket (psil lam t) (H lam * psi lam t)
          - braket (psi lam t) (H lam * psil lam t) := by
      rw [hderiv_exp]
    _ = Complex.I * hbar * deriv (fun l => braket (psi l t) (psit l t)) lam
          - Complex.I * hbar * braket (psil lam t) (psit lam t)
          - braket (psi lam t) (H lam * psil lam t) := by
      rw [h2]
    _ = Complex.I * hbar * deriv (fun l => braket (psi l t) (psit l t)) lam
          - Complex.I * hbar * braket (psil lam t) (psit lam t)
          + Complex.I * hbar * braket (psit lam t) (psil lam t) := by
      rw [h3]
